status: Guide /14's source (Fable, 2026-11-08, brief 102's sweep): the AI-sounding words, Sky's four rejected lines and the lines of today's text.json that carry such a word. Older guides never read it.
why: Sky 2026-11-08, on the four lines Fable kept on purpose: "not into those e.g. 'Citizen. Walking is encouraged. Running is noted.' - that noted is AI sounding". None of the four stays as it is, and AI-sounding words fail the bar: no person in the street says them.

rejected.line: Citizen. Walking is encouraged. Running is noted.
rejected.why: Sky's own example: "that noted is AI sounding". A recorded 1950s announcement would ask the citizen to walk; it would never log him.

rejected.line: I remember them, officer. Here, let me tell you what happened.
rejected.why: Kept on purpose (questioned, so remembering was the answer); Sky: none of the four stays. It still says the game's word, remember, for the player.
Kept on purpose as police radio; Sky: none of the four stays. It is a procedure read out, not policemen talking.

rejected.line: The east yard. I'll give you a couple of minutes there, and then I drive on.
rejected.why: The driver in the Pay conversation, kept on purpose as his own terms; Sky: none of the four stays. It reads out the bay's window.

fail.why: NATURAL: "noted" is a computer logging an event. The patrol is a 1950s machine with a recorded voice.

fail.line: Alarm noted. Proceeding to the scene.
fail.why: NATURAL: two of Sky's words in four. A clockwork patrol says what it wants of the citizen, never a status.
NATURAL: a robot from a later century's films. The machine's phrases are polite city regulations, not acknowledgements.

fail.line: A disturbance has been noted. Please remain still.
fail.why: NATURAL: "has been noted" is the form's voice.

fail.line: I drive the Councillor. Nothing else. Noted.
